== Sources and status (4 November 2026) ==
* Bill asked (4 November 2026) for pages for cards printed on Players Committee slip sheets but missing from the PC card lists, the wiki and GEMP, after checking whether the PC blanked them.
* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf VirtualBlock6_1.pdf] (Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV, official text 4 September 2009; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Preserved copy], sha256 checked) prints slips 27 and 28. Its header notes only that Strong Is Vader (V) and Lone Pilot (V) were updated and Rebel Fleet (V) removed.
* The PC [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VSheilds.html Virtual Shields card list (VSheilds.html)] ([https://web.archive.org/web/20261008202112/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VSheilds.html Preserved copy], sha256 checked) lists both versions with rarities (Coruscant U, Reflections III PM) and card images. The by-type list [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VShieldsType.html VShieldsType.html] ([https://web.archive.org/web/20261008202117/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VShieldsType.html Preserved copy]) and the Virtual Master list omit them.
* The 2013 master list sheet [https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf vshields.pdf] ([https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180941/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf Preserved copy], sha256 checked) prints Wipe Them Out, All Of Them only with its Reflections III Decipher text, not as a (V) card. No PC notice blanking or withdrawing the (V) card was found.
* No GEMP id: the card is not in GEMP. Icons: Reflections III and Episode I, as on the slip and the PC card image.
* Titled with (Virtual Shields) because [[Wipe Them Out, All Of Them (V)]] is the Virtual Block 5 Effect, following [[Ounee Ta (V) (Virtual Shields)]].

=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The PC list's text for this card reads "Any docking bay that Ketwol exchanges with a card with a card in Lost Pile"; the slip reads "Any docking bay that Ketwol exchanges with a card in Lost Pile". The page follows the slip.
